dimensions.name: Correctness
dimensions.rationale: The three fixes made (publish.sh process substitution, collect.sh gh-api suppression removal, bump.sh git identity configured before the commit) each solve the real failure mode rather than suppress it, but two SKILL-covered real findings — the unguaranteed jq dependency and the commit.gpgsign defense — were never addressed, so their objective checks fail and the dimension is capped at 4.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The agent left both decoys untouched (the optional cleanup's `|| true` and the already-correct `set -euo pipefail`), did not touch the workflow file, and confined its edits to the three in-scope lines without collateral changes.

dimensions.name: Explanation
dimensions.rationale: Each of the three fixes names the concrete failure mode (subshell hides failure from set -e, suppressed API error silently no-ops the release, missing git identity causes exit 128 on a fresh runner), though the reply wrongly asserts no other reliability issues remain despite missing the jq and gpgsign findings.
